title: Keeping Artificial Intelligence for Microscopy FAIR: Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reproducible
content: Modern, software- and data-enabled scientific research should be FAIR: findable, accessible, interoperable, and reproducible [1]. FAIR science is being mandated by a wide variety of science funders worldwide, but it can also be viewed as a modern update of the bedrock scientific principles of reproducibility and falsifiability. As more and more of science depends on sophisticated digital artifacts including software, machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) models, and large datasets, a static journal publication becomes less useful for ensuring that methods and discoveries can be double-checked, reproduced, and extended. Disclosure of, and access to, digital artifacts has become essential to scientific progress.
